intro: Cybersecurity, government, and technology sectors faced significant threats in recent weeks, with incident response coverage spanning 14 articles from April 13 to May 2, 2026. The most severe vulnerability observed was CVE-2025-59718, carrying a CVSS score of 9.8. Affected regions included Europe, North America, the United States, Venezuela, and global networks. The severity mix comprised one informational, seven high, two critical, and one medium alert.
